rationale.consistency: Mirrors trimPathPrefix's structure, doc-comment style and EqualFold usage; introduces a stricter isHex-based escape check than the prefix's simpler '%' heuristic, a small stylistic divergence.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles decoded-suffix vs %xx path, escaped suffix requiring literal escape, case-insensitive hex, empty suffix, suffix longer than path, and same-position escapes on both sides.
rationale.scope: Only touches the suffix call site, adds the new helper, and removes the now-dead reverse(); nothing else changed.
rationale.readability: Clear backward-iteration loop with well-placed comments explaining the escape-alignment rule; names (endsEscape, isHex) are self-explanatory.
rationale.robustness: All slicing guarded by i>=3 in endsEscape; PathUnescape error returns path unchanged; no possible negative indices or panics.
rationale.maintainability: Small, focused helpers; some logic duplication with trimPathPrefix is inherent to the mirrored design rather than a shared abstraction, but easy to follow and extend.
